title: Tradeweb Exchange-Traded Funds Update – August 2026
summary: During August, EUR 56.95 billion was executed on the Tradeweb European ETF marketplace, an increase of 25% year-over-year. Trading activity completed via Tradeweb’s Automated Intelligent Execution (AiEX) tool accounted for 96% of tickets and a record 36% of notional volume.
body_markdown:
The following data is derived from trading activity on the[Tradeweb Markets institutional European- and U.S.-listed ETF platforms](https://www.tradeweb.com/our-markets/institutional/equities/etps_funds/) .


#### EUROPEAN-LISTED ETFs


**Total traded volume**


During August, EUR 56.95 billion was executed on the Tradeweb European ETF marketplace, an increase of 25% year-over-year. Trading activity completed via[Tradeweb’s Automated Intelligent Execution (AiEX) tool](https://www.tradeweb.com/our-markets/institutional/trade-cycle/automated-trading/) accounted for 96% of tickets and a record 36% of notional volume.


Adam Gould, Global Head of Equities at Tradeweb, said: "European ETF activity remained robust in August, defying the traditional summer slowdown. We continue to see new clients use our platform, while uptake of our rules-based automated RFQ protocol remains strong, as evidenced by record AiEX volumes in Europe.”


**Volume breakdown**


All three ETF asset classes saw net buying in August, particularly commodities, where ‘buys' exceeded 'sells' by 42 percentage points. Activity in commodity products amounted to 11% of the overall platform flow, up six percentage points from July. Equity and fixed income ETFs represented 70% and 19%, respectively, of total volume traded.


Meanwhile, Global and North America Equities proved to be the most heavily-traded ETF categories for another month.


**Top ten by traded notional volume**


Equity ETFs occupied six of the ten most actively-traded positions in August, while three physical gold products featured in the top five. The iShares Physical Gold ETC led the rankings, followed by the UBS Core MSCI EM UCITS ETF and the iShares Core S&P 500 UCITS ETF.


#### U.S.-LISTED ETFs


**Total traded volume**


Total consolidated U.S. ETF notional value traded in August reached USD 95.3 billion, up 44% year-over-year. The proportion of AiEX transactions and notional volume amounted to 55% and 15%, respectively.


Adam Gould, Global Head of Equities at Tradeweb, said: "Fixed income ETFs gained ground in August, and the prominence of Treasury exposures has highlighted how institutions use ETFs to adjust duration and manage risk efficiently. Similar to Europe, automation adoption shows no signs of slowing down, and we expect this trend to scale as clients become more comfortable with AiEX."


**Volume breakdown**


As a percentage of total notional value, equities accounted for 54% and fixed income for 41%, with the remainder comprising commodity and specialty ETFs.


**Top ten by traded notional volume**


The Vanguard 500 Index Fund ETF retained first place for the tenth consecutive month, while fixed income products filled eight of the remaining nine positions.
